notes.title: Hexologic's Steam Deck Compatibility Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone 👋

Long time no see! Just wanted to let you know that Hexologic runs perfectly fine on Steam Deck - oof what a suprise! 😅 The game has a download size of 446MB and also supports touch screen controls and that's pretty much it - we're still waiting for the official Steam Deck support green tick.

Experiencing any issues on Steam Deck or any other platforms? [url=https://discord.gg/e69WDgdbKW]Let us know on Discord[/url].

Thanks,
MythicOwl Team

notes.title: Achievements Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We saw that for some of you experienced issues with achievements progression after recent content update with Infinite Mode. We addressed them in a new hotfix, that us now available for download. 

Change log:

- Fixed rare issues in which achievements are not unlocking correctly after downloading Infinite Mode
- Fixed rare issue with progression reseting after playing the Infinite Mode
- Fixed other rare occurences where achievements might not unlock
- Minor stability fixes
- Added: Backup fix - Lost your progress? Press Ctrl + F8 to bring up the latest backup. Didn't work? Try with F9 and F10 respectively.



Let us know in the discussions if you still experience these issues - we are doing our best to make your experience with Hexologic bug-free. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New Content Update: Hexologic receives Infinite Mode!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are delighted to finally share a new, major update for Hexologic - the [b]Infinite Mode[/b]! ːsteamthisː

It is a free content update available for everyone who owns Hexologic on Steam, offering a new, infinte way of solving our hexagonal riddles. Once you solve all levels in a biome, an extra tile with infinity sign will pop up next to the special levels icons. It is a gateway to the infinite amount of new levels, prepared for everyone in our community that shared [i]'The game is too short'[/i] feedback ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: A Hotfix now available, addresses trophy related glitch
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

We just wanted to let you know, that Hexologic just received a small hotfix update, that addresses the trophy related issue alongside some minor flaws and bugs. Here is the shortlist:

[list]
[*] Improvements in Steam achievements
[*] Fixed a bug which didn't allow to verify the last level if it was completed on hard difficulty without completing it on normal difficulty first
[*] Compatibility fixes in x86 and Linux builds
[*] Minor stability fixes
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Content Update is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Recently we have been working hard on a number of tweaks and updates to make Hexologic better and more challenging. We listened to your feedback and made our puzzler longer (36 new levels) and more appealing to experienced puzzle fans (no-hud option).

Full list of changes:
36 new levels
2 new worlds
New types of hexes with different abilities
New difficulty setting (limited assists, shuffled hexes)
Soundtrack extended with new, relaxing music
Improved in-game navigation (PC & Nintendo Switch)
Improved overall stability and bug fixes

We hope you will now enjoy Hexologic even more and looking forward to hear your thoughts on it!

MythicOwl Team
